Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 12

“Nourished by sacrifice, the gods will give you the enjoyments you desire. One who enjoys what they have given without offering in return is simply a thief.”

A startling word to choose — thief, not sinner or fool. Krishna frames pure consumption as taking from a system that one has declined to replenish.
